collection.title: Vauxhall Viva 2015 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Viva 2015 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade for the drivers and a 14" on the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Vauxhall Viva which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
